title: Spinning Cat Crossing
one_line_rule: Tap the arrow buttons to hop the spinning cat up across the traffic rows.

brief.intent: Crossy road game but with the spinning cat
brief.notes: Make the cat visibly spin while hopping between rows of traffic.
